record_scope_reconstruction: Entry into Latvia by nonmotorized traffic restricted at three named road posts; motorized passage remains possible. Pāternieki faces Belarus, Terehova and Grebņeva face Russia. This is not a rail closure or an exit restriction.

source_checks.finding: Official operative Order 166, paragraph at lines 1418–1425, names both frontiers and explicitly says entry only by motor vehicles from March 19.
Interior Ministry March 21 explanatory notice identifies the same three road posts and cycle/scooter concerns; broader wording does not override entry-specific operative text.

Primary state transport directorate service gives checkpoint coordinates distinct from waiting areas; all three named sites independently matched. Current directory establishes location, not 2025 operation.
